---
title: "Capability probes"
subtitle: "What else can aws-emulator do that AWS can, via OpenTofu?"
---

{{< include _generated/version-box.md >}}

After the main stack worked, I probed other services and features a typical AWS project uses. Each
probe is a small OpenTofu root module plus a `check.py` that exercises the data plane
(`probes/<name>/`). `probes/run.py` runs each one in a fixed sequence and records every step:

1. `tofu apply`;
2. the check;
3. `tofu plan -detailed-exitcode` (drift);
4. `tofu destroy`.

All probes share one env-only provider configuration (`probes/_common/provider.tf`).

{{< include _generated/probe-counts.md >}}

The status column judges *behaviour vs AWS*. A probe whose `tofu apply` fails on purpose (because
the failure is the finding) is marked "(the finding)".
